title: 외국 생활: 적응하다, 익숙하다, 외롭다
objective: By the end, you can use words like 적응하다, 익숙하다, 낯설다, 외롭다 and 그립다 in short sentences to say how your life abroad is going.
summary: Learn ten words for talking about how life in a new country feels, from the first strange days to getting used to it.

task.title: Use the new words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write, or put in order the words from the word list.

words.exampleMeaning: It's my first time living alone abroad.

words.meaning: to adjust to; to get used to (N에)
words.exampleMeaning: I've gotten used to Korean food now.

words.meaning: to be used to; to feel familiar
words.example: 지하철 타는 게 아직 익숙하지 않아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm still not used to taking the subway.
I feel a bit lonely when I'm alone on weekends.

words.meaning: hometown; the place you come from
to miss (someone or something far away)
words.example: 가끔 엄마가 해 주신 음식이 그리워요.
words.exampleMeaning: Sometimes I miss the food my mom made.

words.meaning: culture; the way people live and do things
words.exampleMeaning: I want to learn more about Korean culture.
I made a Korean friend in a club.

exercises: Choose the right word: 이사한 지 한 달이 지났어요. 이제 새 동네가 (익숙해요 / 외로워요).
Choose the word from the list that means the opposite of 익숙하다: 처음 간 도시는 모든 길이 ____.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list in the -았/었어요 form: 처음에는 매운 음식이 힘들었지만, 지금은 매운 음식에 잘 ____.
Fill in the blank with 외롭다 in the right form: 친구가 아무도 없어서 매일 저녁 너무 ____.
Complete each sentence with 그립다, 사귀다, or 문화 in the right form: ① 비가 오면 고향 음식이 ____. ② 학교에서 새 친구를 ____ 싶어요. ③ 한국의 명절 ____가 재미있어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 적응하고 있어요 / 외국 / 지금 / 생활에
answers: ① 그리워요 ② 사귀고 ③ 문화
지금 외국 생활에 적응하고 있어요. (외국 생활에 지금 적응하고 있어요.)
